queries:
WITH rental_totals AS (
  SELECT p.rental_id, i.store_id, SUM(p.amount) AS total
  FROM payment p
  JOIN rental r ON r.rental_id = p.rental_id
  JOIN inventory i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id
  WHERE p.rental_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY p.rental_id, i.store_id
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(total) AS avg_total FROM rental_totals
)
SELECT rt.store_id,
       SUM(rt.total) AS sum_kept_totals,
       AVG(rt.total - o.avg_total) AS avg_diff
FROM rental_totals rt
CROSS JOIN overall o
WHERE rt.total > o.avg_total
GROUP BY rt.store_id;
SELECT customer_id
FROM (
  SELECT customer_id, AVG(rental_total) AS avg_rental_total
  FROM (
    SELECT customer_id, rental_id, SUM(amount) AS rental_total
    FROM payment
    GROUP BY customer_id, rental_id
  )
  GROUP BY customer_id
)
WHERE avg_rental_total > (SELECT AVG(amount) FROM payment);
SELECT AVG(COALESCE(p.total, 0)) AS average_total_payment
FROM rental r
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT rental_id, SUM(amount) AS total
  FROM payment
  GROUP BY rental_id
) p ON r.rental_id = p.rental_id;
